visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with a white baseball cap and a white/green polo shirt (the host) stands in an indoor hallway near vending machines. He is gesturing and speaking enthusiastically to a young woman wearing a red top. The setting is bright and appears to be a school corridor with lockers or mailboxes in the background. (2) The scene cuts to the host talking to a male student in a grey t-shirt holding a thermos and a bottled drink. The host's expression is animated as he points towards the vending machine. (3) Another cut shows the host interviewing a male student wearing a black baseball cap and a white graphic t-shirt. The host continues to use wide hand gestures while explaining a scenario. (4) The student in the black cap hands a bottle of C&C grape soda to a young woman in a grey and orange uniform. She smiles broadly and laughs. The lighting is consistent and bright throughout. (5) The host is seen laughing and covering his face in a exaggerated comedic reaction. The background remains the same hallway area near the vending machines.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 一日黑松員工實習. [Slogan]: 突襲!! 校園訪問. [Subtitle]: 路過我想請問你一下. (2) [Subtitle]: 比方說我們現在經常來補. [Subtitle]: 補東西嘛. [Variety]: LOSE. (3) [Subtitle]: 那如果說我們把這些. [Subtitle]: 要補的貨 都把它疊在旁邊的話. (4) [Slogan]: Q:如果要補貨的飲料放在投幣機旁邊 發現飲料沒了, 會幫忙補貨進去嗎?. [Subtitle]: 找幾個人 整箱抱走!!. [Variety]: 找幾個人 整箱抱走!!. (5) [Subtitle]: 這是對的. [Subtitle]: 這是女同學的意見. (6) [Subtitle]: 剛剛那邊蝦XX拍照 那些男同學 隨便來一個. (7) [Subtitle]: 那我們把這個箱子 如果就擺在旁邊落好了 你會幫我們補嗎?. (8) [Subtitle]: 我會啊!!. [Variety]: 我會啊!!. (9) [Subtitle]: 你絕對不會因為 它在旁邊 你就順手拿走. (10) [Subtitle]: 可能一兩瓶吧!!. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個同學 相當懂得. [Variety]: “手續費” 的運用. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以我要 我等一下要補貨嗎?. (13) [Subtitle]: 不用不用不用. (14) [Subtitle]: 同學們 你會自行補貨嗎?. (15) [Subtitle]: A:先投10元 然後拿一箱走 這樣子. (16) [Subtitle]: 先投10元 這通常都20元. [Variety]: 這20元欸!!. (17) [Subtitle]: 那我就是投20塊 然後拿兩箱走. [Variety]: “真的很會算”. (18) [Subtitle]: 商學院的嘛!!. (19) [Subtitle]: 謝謝你. [Variety]: 嘿~溫妮!! 我喜歡你!!. (20) [Subtitle]: 他是你的粉絲 並不是我的. [Subtitle]: 如果下次這樣的話 你要不要去後面補貨 我來訪問就好了. [Variety]: 我來訪問就好了.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a promotional variety segment for Heisong (Black Pine) beverages. The host interviews students in a lighthearted, comedic manner about their hypothetical honesty regarding unattended drinks near vending machines, highlighting the brand's presence in schools while entertaining the audience.
